name: Stocky rodent
mustPaint: fat barrel body on very short legs
blunt rounded head with small ears set low in the fur
SHORT furry tail, so tail 0.7 reads as tailless (guinea pig, capybara, hyrax, pika, wombat)
why: 14 misleading. Includes Pika from the Tree Frog and Wombat. Their shared identity is 'round short-legged body, no real tail', which the Civet's long ringed tail breaks. Gopher (incisors) and Agouti (legs) stay caveat.
